request: Battery names reported to the hub are always valid UTF-8: invalid byte sequences coming from firmware are dropped ("LNV-5B11K63024@\xd0" becomes "LNV-5B11K63024@"), and a name left empty by that falls back to the generic "Battery N" name for its position.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(agent): strip invalid UTF-8 from battery names (#2241)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > agent/battery/battery_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestNormalizeBatteriesStripsInvalidUTF8)$' ./agent/battery >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
